title: Anchor v1
description: The external anchor of a digest: a signed annotated git tag `fde-anchor/<kind>/<id>` pushed to the GitHub remote by the case-keeper service identity, never an executor credential (RD-04), with the verifier's own receipt. On a single-operator host it proves not rewritten after the server-recorded push time, not that an executor could not have written it (RD-26); `pusher.credential_scope` records which case applies.

tag.description: fde-anchor/<kind>/<id>; kind and id equal the fields below. The id uses only characters valid in a git ref name.

kind.description: model registration, a freeze, or pre-registration.

subject_ref.description: What the digest is about: a world_ref (model), an episode_ref (freeze) or a pre-registration id (prereg).

digest.description: The anchored digest, lowercase hex, computed under CEP-0008 section 16.5.

identity.description: The case-keeper service identity that pushed the tag.

credential_scope.description: shared_os_user: executors and the case keeper share an OS user; anchoring rows are PARTIAL (RD-26, OD-6). dedicated_anchor_credential: protected tag namespace fde-anchor/* (no delete, no force).

verifier.description: Identity of the verifier; not the pusher.

server_push_time.description: Push time recorded by the remote's server, not by the pusher.

tag_object_id.description: Git object id of the annotated tag.

digest.description: The digest the verifier read from the tag; must equal the anchor digest.
